_comment: The killing mutations named in docs/TEST-PLAN.md, made runnable by scripts/mutate.mjs.
Each entry is a claim: break this, and THAT suite must stop passing.
`from` must match exactly once — a mutation matching zero or many times no longer
describes the code, is reported STALE, and fails the run. That is deliberate: a
mutation nobody has re-read is the same kind of stale record as a task list kept
This is a representative set, one per defect class, not every mutation ever run.

mutations.label: evidence: done status is checked at all
mutations.from: found = next(((i, m) for i, c in enumerate(cells)
mutations.to: found = next(((i, m) for i, c in enumerate(cells[:1])

mutations.label: evidence: exit-0-but-scored-nothing is a failure
evidence: a real result outranks an empty one
mutations.from: return not any(re.search(p, output, re.M) for p in SOMETHING_RAN)

mutations.label: evidence: the digest label the readers parse
evidence: the dirty-tree marker
evidence: the failure fence
mutations.from: block += "\n" + "\n".join(["  ```"] + ["  " + ln for ln in out] + ["  ```"])

mutations.label: evidence: cwd defaults to the repository root
mutations.from: cwd = Path(r.stdout.strip()) if r.returncode == 0 else task.parent

mutations.label: evidence: the append keeps line endings
mutations.from: write_source(task, text[:m.start()] + new + ("\n" + tail if tail else ""), file_newline(task))
mutations.to: task.write_text(text[:m.start()] + new + ("\n" + tail if tail else ""), encoding="utf-8")
